source.method: straight-line fit to the published characteristic curve over one log H window shared by all three channels, [-2.7, -0.8], on the sheet's own log H axis, which prints no unit, anchored to Kodak's lux-second axis at the sheet's printed ISO 400/27° through the ISO 5800 speed point (green and the slower of red and blue, each at minimum density plus 0.15), a shift of +0.50, which makes the window Kodak's [-2.2, -0.3]
source.publication: FilmoTec Datenblatt WOLFEN NC400 (no document code printed, PDF dated 2024-09-16)

name: Wolfen NC400
note: Dye gammas are this stock's own, read off its maker's published characteristic curve. Nothing here is measured from a roll. Its own emulsion. The maker's sheet calls it the first generation of its own 400 ASA colour negative film, names InovisCoat GmbH in its footer, and ties it to no other stock.
